changes: Added automated Question of the Day (QOTD) system: `/settings qotd_channel:<#channel>` sets the channel where the daily question is posted, and `/settings qotd_role:<@&role>` sets the role pinged when it goes out.
Loaded 365 English Minecraft-themed questions from qotd_bank.csv at startup, indexed by day and wrapping around after day 365.

Every day at 00:00 GMT+0 the bot posts a styled English embed in the configured QOTD channel (pinging the configured role), creates a public discussion thread titled "💬 QOTD - <date>" attached to that message, and edits the embed to include the thread link.
The current day index and last post date are persisted in SQLite, so the cycle never resets or repeats if the bot restarts.
Threads are automatically locked after 24 hours (read-only) and archived after 48 hours to keep the server sidebar clean.

All Discord write operations (embed send, thread creation, lock/archive) are wrapped in exponential backoff with HTTP 429/5xx retry handling, safe for a 117k-member server and independent of moderation commands (warn, kick, ban).
